description: Behavioral AC belongs at story level in story-graph.json. Use When/Then format (NO Given - save for scenarios). Each AC is a SINGLE string with one WHEN/THEN pair. Example: "WHEN user enters name THEN system saves to character sheet"

do.description: Each AC is single string with WHEN/THEN together. Example: "WHEN action completes THEN system saves state AND system shows success"

guidance.description: Each acceptance criteria is a single string with WHEN/THEN
example: acceptance_criteria: ["WHEN user enters name THEN system saves to character sheet"]

guidance.description: THEN and its AND belong together in same acceptance criteria
example: acceptance_criteria: ["WHEN action completes THEN system saves state AND system shows success message"]

guidance.description: Each WHEN condition starts a new acceptance criteria
example: "WHEN GM selects tokens THEN system highlights tokens", "WHEN GM selects zero tokens THEN system shows error"

dont.description: Don't split WHEN/THEN across multiple strings. Example: ["WHEN user enters name", "THEN system saves"] (wrong - should be one string)

guidance.description: Don't split WHEN/THEN across multiple strings
example: ["WHEN user enters name", "THEN system saves"] - WRONG: should be one string

guidance.description: Don't separate THEN and its AND into different strings
example: ["THEN system saves state", "AND system shows success"] - WRONG: THEN and AND should be together

guidance.description: Don't combine different WHEN conditions in one AC
example: "WHEN GM selects tokens THEN highlights WHEN GM selects zero THEN error" - WRONG: each WHEN needs own AC
